# Last updated: 2026-07-27

## Why this file exists

This site is JavaScript-rendered, so a crawler that does not execute JS receives
an empty page body. This file carries the full content as plain text. There are
only two pages (the landing page and the booking page), so everything is here.

## Disambiguation

Several people share the name Ahmad Shayan. This file is about exactly one of
them: Ahmad Shayan, Founder and CEO of Ahmasoft, an AI software company based in
Lahore, Pakistan. He is not the concrete-durability researcher of the same name.

Canonical identifiers:
- Personal site and entity page: https://ahmadshayan.com/about
- Entity ID used in structured data: https://ahmadshayan.com/#ahmad-shayan

## What this is

The Claude Code Builder Sprint. Private 1-on-1 coaching that takes a
non-technical operator from zero to a deployed AI tool, usually in one or two
live sessions.

The premise: you do not learn to code. You learn to direct Claude Code, which
writes the code. Setup is point-and-click. Building is conversational. You
prompt, Claude codes, and you finish with working software you own.

- Price: $250 flat for the Sprint
- Format: one or two live sessions, typically about 90 minutes each
- Outcome: a working AI tool deployed to your own accounts
- Guarantee: full $250 refund if nothing is deployed by the end of your Sprint
- After the Sprint: ongoing coaching available at $50/hr, taken up by roughly
  70% of clients
- First discovery call is free

## Who it is for

Non-technical professionals who want to build their own tools rather than wait
on a backlog. Most clients are VPs and directors with no coding background,
including senior leaders at NVIDIA.

## The coach

Ahmad Shayan, Founder and CEO of Ahmasoft. He works two ways: building
production AI systems for companies end to end, and coaching leaders and teams
to build with AI themselves using Claude Code.

Track record: 100% job success score, 54 completed projects, 2,000+ delivered
hours, Top Rated on Upwork, and nine live products shipped under Ahmasoft.

## Frequently asked questions

Q: Do I need to be technical?
A: No. Most clients are VPs and directors with no coding background. Setup is
   point-and-click. Building is conversational. You prompt, Claude codes.

Q: How long does the Sprint take?
A: Most clients finish in two sessions of about 90 minutes each. Technical
   clients often do two sessions of an hour each. Some prefer one longer
   sitting. We pace to fit you, not a fixed clock.

Q: What if I do not know what I want to build?
A: That is what the first 10 minutes are for. Clients arrive with a vague idea
   and leave with a concrete plan.

Q: Will I need to pay for Claude API?
A: Yes, but it is small. Plan on $5 to $15 a month as you build. Cost controls
   are covered in Session 1.

Q: What happens after the Sprint?
A: You leave with everything working and a recall doc as your reference. About
   70% of clients come back for ongoing coaching at $50/hr. The rest take it
   from there on their own.

Q: What is the refund policy?
A: If you do not have a working AI tool deployed by the end of your Sprint, the
   full $250 is refunded. No forms, no friction.

## Booking

https://coach.ahmasoft.com/book

Three session modes: a short fit call, a standard Builder Sprint session
(90 minutes), and a longer deep session. Timezone is selectable, and the booking
page shows real availability.
